verdict.rationale: Substantive text was extracted from the public guidance pages on open.gsa.gov and from sam.gov (entity API parameters, access model, service listings), which indicates the reading surface returns readable content rather than a JS-only shell or challenge page. sam.gov/robots.txt returns HTTP 200 with content paths crawlable to a keyless agent, and the open.gsa.gov probes got ordinary HTTP 404s rather than bot-wall responses. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming a 200 HTML fetch of the guidance pages under a named identified user agent, explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or WAF challenge appears on sam.gov's own pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.
